يشلوا (form I)
# يَشَلُّوا (yašallū) /ja.ʃal.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يَشُلُّوا (yašullū) /ja.ʃul.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يُشَلُّوا (yušallū) /ju.ʃal.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
